name: A creature killed only by the Greater Imp awards the knight experience (#252)
contract: Issue #252 (core feb155c82c75, level 10, Mulgore) reports that a creature solo-killed by the Knight of Xoroth's Greater Imp gives the knight no experience, while assisting does. Summon: Greater Imp 520661 is SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON_PET for creature 510100, taught by the level-10 Greater Imp passive 92101 (AscensionXoroth::Refresh learns 520661 while aura 92101 or 704993 is present), so the imp is a real Pet owned by the knight in the pet slot, and its own Burning Slap 630930 and Imp Rush 630931 are cast by the imp. Unit::Kill rewards the owner of the killer (GetCharmerOrOwnerPlayerOrPlayerItself) and Creature::SetLootRecipient tags the owner of the attacker, but the reward is only allowed when Creature::IsDamageEnoughForLootingAndReward holds, which since upstream AzerothCore #11969 also needs _damagedByPlayer. In the reported core Unit::DealDamage set it only for a player, a unit a player moves or a unit a player charms, so a pet-only kill gave no XP or loot. 7f7131c76 (#4221, after the report) counts damage from a player-controlled unit owned by a player, with the stated intent that a creature killed only by a player's minions is lootable and worth experience; the Greater Imp is such a unit. Expected on current main: the imp alone kills a level-10 Harvest Golem, the knight never swings, and the knight's XP rises while the knight stays level 10. The golem's 300 health exceeds its level 11-12 template health (at most 247), so the imp's damage clears the player damage requirement whichever health it was sized from.

steps.label: Force the Greater Imp passive aura
SETUP: the Greater Imp passive teaches Summon: Greater Imp
SETUP: the Greater Imp is the knight's pet
Let the pet's spells and autocast settle
Send only the imp to attack
SETUP: the Greater Imp kills the golem
SETUP: the knight never swung at the golem, so the imp killed it alone
The imp's solo kill awards the knight experience
The XP gain did not cross a level, so the XP delta is meaningful
